# SugarAI
> SugarAI (formerly SugarCRM) is the Precision Selling Platform — a B2B CRM that uses AI and ERP data to help sellers know where to focus, who to engage, and what to do next. 4,000+ customers across 120+ countries.
SugarAI is built for mid-to-large B2B organizations with complex account management, large product catalogs, and repeat-purchase customer bases. It integrates natively with 180+ ERP systems to surface buying behavior changes, revenue risks, and expansion opportunities. Nucleus Research found 32% lower total cost of ownership compared to Salesforce.
## Products
- [Sugar Sell](https://sugarai.com/product/sugar-sell): AI-powered sales automation with guided selling, pipeline management, and account intelligence
- [Sugar Sales Intelligence](https://sugarai.com/product/sugar-sales-intelligence): Revenue intelligence from ERP data — buying behavior analysis, account risk detection, and expansion opportunities
- [Sugar Market](https://sugarai.com/product/sugar-market): Marketing automation with multi-channel campaigns, lead scoring, and analytics
- [Sugar Serve](https://sugarai.com/product/sugar-serve): Customer service platform with case management and self-service portals
## Industries
- [Manufacturing](https://sugarai.com/industries/manufacturing): Strongest vertical — ERP integration, complex account management, repeat-purchase optimization
- [All Industries](https://sugarai.com/industries): Also serves wholesale, distribution, financial services, software, and business services
## Proof
- [Case Studies](https://sugarai.com/case-studies): Customer results including +44% annual sales (Creative Foam), +1100% pipeline (Tetley), +$3.8M in 2 months (Essendant)
- [Analyst Reports](https://sugarai.com/resources): Nucleus Research leader designation, ROI studies, ERP integration benchmarks
## Company
- [About SugarAI](https://sugarai.com/about/about-us): Company background, mission, and history
- [Security & Trust](https://sugarai.com/legal/security-trust): ISO 27001, SOC2 Type 2, GDPR compliance, AWS hosting
## Optional
- [Blog](https://sugarai.com/blog): Sales trends, product updates, and customer stories
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.sugarai.com): Third-party integrations and add-ons
- [Contact Sales](https://sugarai.com/contact/contact-sales): Sales inquiries and pricing
- [Pricing](https://sugarai.com/pricing): Custom packaging based on company size and requirements

Built to help sellers sell 
What if your sales team always knew where to focus, why it mattered, and what to do next? That’s the idea behind Sugar Sell. It shows reps the right accounts, opportunities, and actions – every time they log in. 
Clear priorities
Sugar Sell shows reps which accounts and opportunities matter most right now, so time is spent where it actually moves deals forward. 
Built-in guidance
Sellers see why something needs attention and what to do next, without digging through dashboards or guessing where to focus.
Better preparation 
Every interaction starts with context – what’s changed, where risk is building, and where there’s room to grow – so reps show up ready. 
With Sugar, sales reps engage in customer conversations armed with insights on current and potential purchases.
Steve Jiran
Vice President of Parts Sales

For sales leaders

For sales operations and IT 
Sugar improves adoption and ROI by being genuinely useful for sellers. By connecting CRM and ERP data, it reduces manual reporting and delivers clear, explainable insights sales can act on.

FAQ
How is Sugar Sell different from a traditional CRM?
Most CRMs focus on tracking activity and reporting on what already happened, leaving sellers to decide where to focus on their own. Sugar Sell is designed to guide sellers on what to focus on next, using context from customer, product, and sales data. 
What data does Sugar Sell use to guide sellers? 
Sugar Sell combines CRM data with ERP data like order history and customer activity. It analyzes changes in buying behavior to surface account risk, expansion opportunities, and the deals most likely to close – without sellers having to dig through reports. 
How quickly do sales teams see value? 
Sugar Sell is built around sellers’ daily work and goals, so teams typically see value quickly. When sellers log in, they immediately see their top priorities for the day, including where to focus, who to engage, and what to do next. 
What types of sales teams and industries is Sugar Sell built for? 
Sugar Sell is designed for teams managing many customer accounts, large product catalogs, and ongoing and long-term customer relationships. It’s commonly used in industries like manufacturing, distribution, and wholesale. 
How does AI factor into Sugar Sell? 
Sugar Sell uses AI to deliver contextual intelligence, which means understanding what’s happening in an account, why it’s happening, and what a seller should do next. By combining customer behavior, purchase history from ERP, and sales activity, Sugar Sell highlights changes in buying patterns, potential risks, and growth opportunities in the context of each account and opportunity. That context helps sellers prepare for meetings and take the right next actions to move deals forward. AI also keeps the CRM up to date after meetings, so sellers spend less time on admin and more time selling. 
SugarAI is a leading sales CRM for B2B growth. Join the move.

Sugar FAQs
How is SugarAI different from other CRMs, like Salesforce and HubSpot?
While SugarAI, Salesforce and HubSpot can deliver similar functionality and results, one of the main differences with SugarAI is how easy it is to achieve those results and what it costs you.
You can customize SugarAI to your specific business needs with no coding or minimal coding, while Salesforce often requires significant coding and developer expertise. HubSpot provides customization options primarily focused on ease of use, but without the same depth and flexibility as SugarAI.
In a nutshell? We offer great performance and extensive customization at a lower total cost of ownership. 
What is it like to do business with SugarAI compared to other vendors?
When SoftwareReviews surveyed more than 1,000 CRM users about how they felt about their CRM provider, SugarAI stood out in a few key areas. Compared to Salesforce and HubSpot, SugarAI was found to be more efficient and effective in terms of service, more generous and altruistic with contracts, and over delivered instead of over promised – while achieving similar scores for product performance, productivity and reliability.
SugarAI is not only designed to meet your sales, service and marketing automation needs, we’re dedicated to making sure you succeed.
How does SugarAI integrate with other systems?
SugarAI 
integrates
 with a wide range of systems and tools, both natively as connectors and through third-party add-ons in our 
marketplace
. Our solutions integrate seamlessly with new and legacy technology to remove data siloes and merge front-and back-office systems, such as ERP systems. This allows you to surface insights that help you grow revenue faster. In addition, SugarAI supports REST APIs and SOAP APIs to help you integrate with any existing tool or system.
What types of businesses is SugarAI best suited for?
SugarAI is a good fit for mid- to large-size organizations that need sales, revenue intelligence marketing and service automation that matches their specific workflows. We are particularly strong for companies that have sophisticated account management requirements – those companies that rely on repeat sales from their existing customer base. We provide 
industry-specific solutions
 for manufacturing, wholesale distribution, software and high tech, business services, financial services, and many more. If your business relies on an ERP system, our CRM can integrate with it and deliver 
AI insights
 that help you stay competitive, like finding out which customers haven’t purchased recently, or who is buying one product but not another.
Which tier of Sugar Sell is right for me?
We don’t want to sell you features you don’t need. Instead of trying to calculate the costs of our CRM on your own, get in touch with us and we’ll put together a package based on your requirements. Let us know the size of your company, the number of licenses you might need, the products you’re interested in, and the length of the contract you would like to commit to, and we’ll put together an offer just for you.
What support and onboarding services are included with SugarAI?
Sugar offers a wide range of support options, from online-only to full 24/7 global response, depending on the Sugar solution you choose and your business needs. We offer comprehensive migration, onboarding and adoption programs to maximize your investment, as well as professional services and one-time support for strategic projects. Our team will work with you to find a services solution that fits your timeline and budget. Work with us directly or choose one of our trusted partners.
Can I customize SugarAI to fit my specific business needs?
Yes, SugarAI is highly customizable, without requiring extensive coding, making it a more affordable option compared to other CRMs. Whether you require specific features, workflows, or integrations, our platform offers extensive no-code configuration capabilities, both directly in the platform or through professional service engagements. Many configuration options are available to you free of charge. Tell us about your requirements, and we’ll 
show you a demo
 based on your needs.
What is the typical implementation timeline for SugarAI?
The implementation timeline varies depending on the complexity of your project, spanning from a couple of weeks to a few months. Typically, we see deployment times that are significantly faster than Salesforce, which can require extensive coding and technical support. In addition, unlike other CRMs, you have the option to work directly with the Sugar team or implement through a partner.
What results can I expect from using SugarAI?
When it comes to CRM costs, Nucleus Research found that compared to Salesforce, SugarAI users can lower their total cost of ownership by up to 32%, while using similar functionality. But the real benefit to your business comes through increased revenue through streamlined sales and enhanced insights. Manufacturer 
Tetley Harris
 increased their pipeline 1100% with SugarAI, while 
Creative Foam
 exceeded its annual sales goal by 44% after implementing our CRM. See the results of other companies in our 
case studies
.
What AI features does SugarAI offer?
Sugar provides AI features for predictive, generative and sentiment analysis. Features include content creation, summarization, meeting sentiment analysis and predictive lead scoring, with additional features coming out every quarter. Learn how 
SugarAI’s AI features
 can help you boost productivity and surface key business insights.
How does SugarAI keep my data secure?
Sugar partners with AWS for storage and hosting across several globally distributed locations. We use robust security measures to protect your data, including data encryption in transit and at rest, regular security audits, compliance with industry standards like ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2, GDPR and customization options to meet specific industry regulation requirements. Data that is hosted in an AWS region never leaves that region. Learn more about 
SugarAI’s security
.
